business_problem: Maya needed a unified real-time lakehouse because legacy architecture limited the scale of underwriting, fraud analytics, and personalized customer experiences across its financial ecosystem.
solution_summary: Maya uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow to support real-time fintech lending, fraud, and personalization. Maya needed a unified real-time lakehouse because legacy architecture limited the scale of underwriting, fraud analytics, and personalized customer experiences across its financial ecosystem. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Transaction, claims, risk, and event data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports Making banking more accessible and secure $2.1 billion, Dispersed for loans with advanced ML-powered underwriting Up to 98%, and Reduction in fraud loss with transactional sequence embedding 45%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Maya reported Making banking more accessible and secure $2.1 billion, Dispersed for loans with advanced ML-powered underwriting Up to 98%, and Reduction in fraud loss with transactional sequence embedding 45%, improving real-time fintech lending, fraud, and personalization with measurable gains in revenue growth, risk reduction, customer experience, and scalability.
